purpose: The clip on either side of a hybrid look switch (Sketch to Life, Canvas to Life, Canvas to 3D). The dissolve itself happens in the edit (0.3-0.4 s); the two clips must meet on one matched pose or framing.
camera_default: [Static shot] for the last second of the outgoing clip and the first second of the incoming clip
match_rule: The outgoing clip's END pose and framing are written in full (body, head angle in screen terms, hands, eye line, frame position), and the incoming clip's first frame is a keyframe rendered in the next mode from that same written pose. hybrid/canvas planners refuse a switch without a match key (SWITCH_POSE_MISMATCH).
hold_rule: Each style is held at least 3 s (7.2 s for Version E); no flicker.
lipsync_rule: No lip-sync on sketch or painted shots in hybrid looks; Canvas to 3D lip-syncs only on lifelike 3D close-ups.
negatives: no style blending inside the clip
no pose drift in the last second
beats_pattern: action -> slow into the match pose -> hold the match pose at least 1 s
